Upstream: https://github.com/rhizoome/tree-sitter-ink2 (MIT OR Apache-2.0)

Vendored / generated files under this directory must match the Tree-sitter ABI
linked by DVUI (see zig-pkg tree_sitter dependency, currently 0.27.x).

Root inputs (sync from upstream `main` when bumping the grammar):
  grammar.js
  tree-sitter.json

Regenerate C sources (requires tree-sitter CLI on PATH):
  cd vendor/tree-sitter-ink2
  tree-sitter generate

That refreshes at least: src/parser.c, src/grammar.json, src/node-types.json,
and src/tree_sitter/parser.h. Hand-written src/scanner.c is kept as-is unless
upstream changes it.
